# Feature: MIG-015 Solo local identity without privilege transfer

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-23 -->

## Intent

Persist a stable solo/loopback host identity on disk and keep it in a separate trust domain from remote Better Auth sessions — no forged headers, no public solo bind, no silent solo→remote privilege transfer.

## Preconditions

- GATE-02 APPROVED Variant A (cookies); MIG-010/011/013/014 on main
- Epic #773; no production cutover / Supabase shutdown
- Target path: `server/src/auth/solo` (GATE-02 row 7 / PoC common-7 patterns)

## Happy Path

- [ ] Same `SAGATREE_DATA_DIR` across host restart restores the same solo `actorId`; ownership rows keyed by that id remain valid (no new owner per start)
- [ ] Remote-facing HTTP/WS with forged `x-solo-user` / `localIdentity` claims are denied; no remote GM/account is created from solo proof
- [ ] Solo→remote reuse of local ownership requires explicit account-link; missing link returns `ACCOUNT_LINK_REQUIRED` (not silent full access)

## Edge Cases

- [ ] `SAGATREE_HOST_MODE=solo` + non-loopback bind → fail closed `SOLO_REQUIRES_LOOPBACK` before listen
- [ ] Account-link with mismatched/foreign `soloActorId` → deny (`ACCOUNT_LINK_MISMATCH`); does not rewrite host identity
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict)

## Regression

- [ ] MIG-010 identity persistence self-test still PASS (same `host-identity.json` path)
- [ ] MIG-014 cookie remote session path still PASS; GoTrue `auth-context` primary path unchanged

## Assumptions

- Full Colyseus room join lands later; remote “join” for this slice = whoami / project-touch / session-ws + policy ownership
- Explicit link is host-local durable mapping solo actorId → remote Better Auth user id (no cloud IdP merge)

## Security Coverage

| ID | How |
| --- | --- |
| B-01 | Solo headers/body claims never become Actors on remote paths |
| B-04 | Policy deny before ownership projection; link required for solo-owned resources under remote actors |
| B-07 | Deny codes only; identity file contents never echoed in errors |
| SC-01 | Solo trust domain separate from cookie sessions |
| SC-02 | Solo public bind fail-closed; forged identity fail-closed |
| SC-03 | Link only to this host’s persisted solo actorId |
| SC-06 | No client-chosen elevation; membership/ownership from durable store + explicit link |

## Implementation Notes

- `server/src/auth/solo/**` — identity file, forged-claim detector, bind guard (`SOLO_REQUIRES_LOOPBACK`), explicit account-link store
- `server/src/config/load-config.ts` — explicit solo + non-loopback fails closed before listen
- `server/src/modules/identity` — remote resolve attaches `linkedSoloActorIds`; `linkSoloToRemoteAccount`
- `server/src/modules/permissions` — solo-owned resources under remote actors → `ACCOUNT_LINK_REQUIRED` until linked
- Routes: `POST /api/solo/link-account`, `POST /api/world-touch` ownership canary; forged claims on whoami/WS/world-touch
- Self-test: `scripts/mig-015-solo-local-identity.self-test.mjs` (wired into `test-gate`)
